items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Manny Mineta come up there with us a while. Yeah, he told us he did. Yeah, he come up. He played with us a while.

ctx.x: Yeah, very awesome. 35, Rampart and Girard. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

Then we had, uh, Dandy Lewis on bass. You heard of him. Yeah, I've heard Bess talk about him. That's right. Dandy Lewis. That's who we had on bass. Then after Buddy Johnson left, we taken Earl Umphrey on trombone. He played up there with us. Then... Manny Mineta come up there with us a while. Yeah, he told us he did. Yeah, he come up. He played with us a while. We had a nice band. Five band. We used to have two bands. Celestine, our band, and they had the big carnival bars. They hired two bands. Sometime they'd…
Something like that? Or was it Lawson?

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: And then I left and went to Los Angeles, and I mean, Manuel Manetta, and Wade Will and Mutt Carey.

ctx.x: The way he went, I just remember now. So, uh, I played around with different fellas until, uh, 1919. And then I left and went to Los Angeles, and I mean, Manuel Manetta, and Wade Will and Mutt Carey.
They never did draft you, huh?

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: I told them, well Alfred Williams kept a good time.

ctx.x: No, he had quit playing. He was playing guitar when I left there. Oh really? Then he went back to the drum. I was so old and he couldn't make it. He just got away from it. Go ahead, Nancy. Nah, go ahead. Thanks.

So, alright. We started playing that night, playing all them numbers and you know Wade had a habit when he was talking. Y'all used to call him Busher. So, alright. He said, you know something? Man, if I had a lineup like this, go to California, Cali. Cali, we clean up. I said, let me tell you, a white band right around the corner of my house. He was begging for a band. I'm there. Oh man. I said, leave any time. Yeah? Now I'm playing at Walter's Place. Alright. Got together. Pop a mug, pop a mug, pop a mug, roll a…
news got out there, you know. And all the movies started, you know. So, we made it out of time.
